pairs.subject: optional-dependency-degradation
pairs.evidence: src/features/admin/integrations/IntegrationsPanel.tsx:98 Provider connect surfaces dispatch per provider identifier so each available integration supplies its own dedicated setup affordance rather than leaving capabilities unreachable or mis-mapped.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/integrations/ingest-guard.ts:42 Rate limit integer variables fall back to derived defaults when unset, but fail fast at boot/import when malformed, naming the variable and bad value.

src/lib/integrations/ingest-guard.ts:141 Unconfigured ingest endpoints return 503 Service Unavailable rather than 401/404, while UI surfaces hide unconfigured affordances and metrics APIs report exact skip counts.
src/lib/integrations/ingest-token.ts:98 Hardening eliminated the legacy fallback dev secret so an unconfigured deployment fails closed instead of allowing forged writes under an unhardened default.
src/lib/integrations/ingest-token.ts:71 Ingest tokens are minted via a function that throws when the secret is unset, paired with the isIngestConfigured companion predicate that callers check.

src/app/api/integrations/ingest/v1/metrics/route.ts:34 Exporters sending OTLP/protobuf to the JSON metrics receiver receive an actionable HTTP 415 error rather than a silent 202 phantom success with dropped data.
.env.example:334 The .env.example template documents the blast radius, unset refusal behavior (503), and rotation scope for INTEGRATIONS_INGEST_SECRET.
src/lib/integrations/copilot.ts:119 The Copilot sync probes GitHub's API directly and categorizes failures into typed denied/absent/unreachable reasons, returning honest 403/422/502 responses.
